top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a mature, fundamental GLP-1 physiological achievement with exceptional demonstrated therapeutic consequence in diabetes and obesity. Its three-person attribution is defensible if the award remains confined to the discoveries of GLP-1 physiology that enabled therapy, rather than the broader later drug-development enterprise.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile; my documented RNA-processing and single-cell research does not establish a conflict with the proposed achievement.
